name: Ghoul

items.name: Consume Flesh
items.text:
Requirements The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour.

---
Effect The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 1d6 healing Hit Points.

It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

items.name: Ghoul Fever
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 15 Fortitude save

---

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 2d6 void damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 2d6 void damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a Ghoul the next midnight.

items.name: Paralysis
items.text: Any living, non-elf creature hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

items.name: Swift Leap
items.text: The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

text:
Ghouls are ravenous undead who haunt graveyards and eat corpses.

---

Few creatures are more ubiquitous to sinister locations such as lonely graveyards and ruined crypts than the flesh-eating undead known as ghouls.
